mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 3% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressures, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% and SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tight labor market, which leads to wage inflation and increased corporate costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases and SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -2% and SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS > 200k & UNRATE < 4% and SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.5% and SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real final sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases and SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals an economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 QoQ < -1% and SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
